title: Cardputer NC1020 1.1 G0 save and cross-worker restore on Device Service 1.99.0

execution.environment: Isolated macOS Device Service 1.99.0 / native Xtensa QEMU / normal timing / offline

checks.detail: Both fresh workers booted the exact populated snapshot of the original factory application.
Native SPI model completed 407 and 410 CMD17 blocks before any input on the respective workers.
One real G0 action saved a new 99384-byte state. Worker B restored the exact exported card and its stopped file hash matched worker A.
All six timed native frames were nonblack and incomplete. The post-input frame remained unchanged.
Physical hardware and browser WASM were outside this isolated native replay.
The 1.99 runtime was not instrumented for SPI lock attribution and no Burner submission was run.

notes: No code change or new firmware build. Two exited guests, zero active leases, released Flash and retained history.
